questions.question: What did the Teacher in Ecclesiastes tell a young man to do while he is young?

answers.text: Rejoice and let his heart be glad
Labor and let his hands be busy
Be still and let his face be sober

questions.question: The Teacher in Ecclesiastes told a young man that God will bring him to judgment for the things he does. True or false?
The Teacher in Ecclesiastes told young people to remember their Creator before what comes?
At the end of his words about youth and growing old, the Teacher in Ecclesiastes says everything is futile. True or false?
